fossils.title: DELIRIUM

MJC165 “delirium”
released February 2 2008 as a CDr limited to 33 copies.

fossils.title: GRASS ROOT
fossils.about:
MJC104 “Grass Root”
released April 9 2007, a CDr limited to 23 copies.
Features trio of Jeremy Buchan, Scott Johnson and David Payne.
o.g. write-up: “mixed bag Fossils trio @ hq. 2 cuts from march madness, 1 mic ghetto style corpse draggin back to our lair, lawnmower man vibes electro crust tape fugg, all with a feedback shard in yr collapsing skull&some as Fossils Broken Beak duo payne vs. scojo in doubling detuned prepared guitar series of strung out string outs notes and faint chords breakthru spring snowstorm. 8 tracks in 60 minutes.”

fossils.title: MORBID CHICKEN
fossils.about:
MJC50 “Morbid Chicken”
Released April 6 2006 as a CDr edition of 25 re-issue of a micro-edition of 8 on no label.
Features trio of Jeremy Buchan, Scott Johnson and David Payne.
o.g. write-up: "From the broken dreamboat ghetto of Ontario's SteelCity it's the f0SSIL$-~- what is this? Arnold Dreyblatt on mescaline? No. It's not. Acoustic guitar, horn,electronics &tapes all thrown in toxic lake. Rhythmic machine of death. “
